Raj (Support): Escalation -> Beaconly onboarding blocked. Intermittent 403 on SAML token exchange (aud mismatch). Customer in onboarding cohort; renewal ~5w. Raised INC-9003. Need CS to lead comms + enablement while SE triages.

Maya (CS): Thanks Raj. Can you confirm if failure is limited to a specific browser/IdP? Also who is the Beaconly POC?

Raj (Support): Failing across IdPs (Okta + OneLogin) and browsers. POC = Clara (clara@beaconly.com). Short repro: 
```
1) Add SAML metadata to tenant
2) Trigger /api/provision with embed scope
3) Token exchange returns 403: "audience_invalid"
```
Logs: "auth: aud mismatch expected 'redwood-service' got 'redwood-embed'". ~10% of first-run attempts fail.

Maya (CS): Marking P0 for CS handoff due to onboarding impact + renewal. Proposed comms plan: 1) Send customer one-pager (ETA + mitigation), 2) Offer immediate manual provisioning for high-priority users, 3) Book 30m enablement slot, 4) Add renewal watch in CRM. Tess will own customer comms.

Tess (CSM): I'll draft and send note to Clara. Draft: "Hi Clara - were investigating an intermittent provisioning issue affecting a subset of users. We can provision impacted users manually and run a quick walkthrough. Initial update in ~3h, targeted fix within 24h. Please reply with priority emails." Will post final when sent.

Owen (Solutions Eng): I can own triage. Hypothesis: audience header normalization regression after last deploy. Quick mitigation: accept legacy aud value behind a feature flag while we patch validation. Plan: run aud-enumeration script, enable permissive aud in staging, smoke test, then canary to prod. ETA: initial RCA 3h, staging canary ~2h.

Maya (CS): Owners: Owen = SE owner, Tess = CS owner, Raj = Support logs owner. Maya = coordinator + renewal watch. Tess include manual provisioning play link and offer two walkthrough slots tomorrow morning.

IncidentBot: INC-9003 | Priority: P1 -> P0 (escalated) | Owners: Owen (SE), Tess (CSM) | Status: triage in progress | https://redwood.incidents/INC-9003
